_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Chemistry Syllabus (5070), Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 11, Topics 11.1-11.4. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' column is omitted for the reasons documented in the Grade 10 file. This matches the Grade's own general-outcomes statement, which names exactly four areas: acids/bases/salts, the mole concept, chemical reactions and energy changes, and the Periodic Table. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 11 is modeled as a single term here. STRUCTURAL TERM SPLIT (2026-08-31, not sourced): this file's topics were previously modeled as a single undivided 'Year' block (no real per-topic term/week data exists for this subject/grade). At the user's own explicit request and choice among alternatives offered, the SAME real topics above have now been divided into three roughly-equal-by-content-volume groups, in their original curriculum order, labelled 'Term 1'/'Term 2'/'Term 3' purely so the app can generate and share one term at a time. This division of which topic falls in which term is NOT sourced from any real scheme of work - it is an organizational split only. No topic, sub-topic, competency, or objective was added, removed, or altered; only the grouping changed. Each term's own topics still have no real week_number of their own, so within a term the app's existing calendar-pacing engine spreads them algorithmically across that term's real teaching weeks, exactly as it already did for the whole undivided Year block before this split.

subject.name: Chemistry
subject.description: Senior Secondary Chemistry syllabus (5070), Grade 10-12 (Curriculum Development Centre, 2013).

sub_topics.name: 11.1.1 Characteristic Properties of Acids and Bases

competencies.description: Describe acids, bases or alkalis in terms of ions they contain or produce in aqueous solution
Describe the meaning of weak, strong, dilute and concentrated acids and alkalis
Describe the pH scale
Describe neutrality, acidity and alkalinity in terms of pH value
Determine the pH value of a solution
Demonstrate the characteristic properties of acids
Demonstrate the characteristic properties of bases
Illustrate the importance of acid-base reactions
State the uses of acids and bases
Describe what a salt is
Classify salts
Demonstrate the preparation of an insoluble salt
Demonstrate the preparation of soluble salts
Describe the various types of oxides

sub_topics.name: 11.1.4 Identification of Ions and Gases (Qualitative Analysis)

competencies.description: Demonstrate the identity of aqueous cations and anions
Demonstrate the identity of gases
Describe what Relative Atomic Mass and relative molecular mass are
Calculate the relative formula mass of a compound
Describe what a mole is
Determine the physical mass of any substance using molar mass and the physical volume of any gas at r.t.p, and vice versa
Describe the relationship of Avogadro's law to reacting moles and volumes of gases at r.t.p and s.t.p
Determine the concentration of a solution applying the dilution law
Illustrate calculations involving stoichiometric reacting moles and volumes of gases and solutions
Calculate the percentage yield in a reaction and the percentage purity of a substance
Determine the limiting reagent in a given reaction
Demonstrate calculations involving different types of acid-base titration reactions
Calculate the percentage composition of elements in a compound
Determine the empirical formula of a compound given the molecular formula
Determine the empirical and molecular formulae using percentage composition or masses
Describe the rate of a chemical reaction
Demonstrate the factors that affect the rates of chemical reactions
Describe methods of controlling the rate of chemical reactions
Describe the effect of a catalyst on the activation energy
Describe what chemical equilibrium is
Describe the effect on the position of equilibrium of a reaction upon changing conditions
Describe what oxidation and reduction is
Describe what a redox reaction is
Identify oxidizing and reducing agents in a reaction
Demonstrate how to determine the oxidation number of an element with variable valency in a compound/ion
Deduce a redox reaction using oxidation numbers
Describe what a non-redox reaction is
Identify the characteristics of oxidizing and reducing agents
Describe what endothermic and exothermic reactions are
Determine whether a reaction is endothermic or exothermic
Describe endothermic and exothermic reactions in relation to bonds
Identify activation energy for a catalysed and uncatalysed reaction on an energy level diagram
Explain the advantages and disadvantages of energy sources (fuels)
Describe the effects of the use of fuels on the environment
Describe the use of silver halide in photography
Describe respiration and photosynthesis in terms of energy changes
Describe the use of radioactive isotopes in relation to energy changes
Explain batteries as a convenient source of electrical energy
Describe what the Periodic Table is
Identify vertical columns and horizontal rows
Use the Periodic Table to classify elements
Describe trends in various Groups given information about the elements
Describe the physical and chemical properties of elements in Group I, II, VII and VIII
Describe the importance of halogens
Describe the harmful effects of halides
Use the noble gases in providing an inert atmosphere
Describe what transition metals are
Describe general properties of transition metals
Describe the uses of transition metals
